description: The FIRST offer of the "$100 → $120" journey: the Top Movers board's top 5 trading vehicles of EVERY kind (stocks, crypto, theme baskets, funds, event cards, WTA markets) ranked by 30-day return, plus the board's best box pairs (long one anti-correlated leg, short the other, with what the box made over 30 days). Every row carries its `setup`: the exact next tool call that sets the trade up (a crypto vehicle → theme_journey_route_vehicle then theme_journey_trade_vehicle; a card → trade_event_card; a theme → theme_journey_route / theme_journey_trade; a stock → the user's own linked brokerage; a fund or WTA market → its page). Read-only; a 30-day return is description, never a forecast. Offer to set one up; place nothing until the user names it, the amount, and confirms. (no key needed)

usdc_amount.description: optional: the amount the user named, so each setup is pre-sized
